matching.subject: You're matched for {{month}} 🎾
body: You've been matched for a league game in {{month}}.
Go ahead… make the first move 😉
Please reply all with a few dates and times you're available so you can get your match on the calendar.
You're free to choose the date, time, and location that work best for both of you.
You can view match details and log your score here:
👉 {{leagueLink}}
matching.signoff:
Have fun and happy hitting,
Net Worth

reminder.subject: Reminder: {{daysLeft}} days left to play your match!
body: Just a friendly reminder that you have {{daysLeft}} days left to play your match with {{opponentName}} this month.
If you haven't connected yet, now's a great time to reach out!
Their email: {{opponentEmail}}
Their availability: {{opponentAvailability}}

sitOutConfirmation.subject: You're sitting out {{month}}
body: This confirms you've chosen to sit out match assignments for {{month}}.
You won't be assigned a match until you toggle back in.
To rejoin, just log into your dashboard and click the button to start playing again.
sitOutConfirmation.signoff:
See you back on the court soon!
Net Worth

rejoinConfirmation.subject: Welcome back! You're in for {{month}}
body: Great news! You're back in the match queue.
You'll be assigned a match starting {{eligibleMonth}}.
rejoinConfirmation.signoff:
Looking forward to seeing you play!
Net Worth

welcome.subject: Welcome to Net Worth Tennis! 🎾
body: Welcome to Net Worth Tennis!
You're officially part of LA's East Side women's tennis community.
What happens next:
• You'll receive your first match assignment at the start of next month
• Log into your dashboard to set your availability preferences
• Connect with the community in our WhatsApp group
Your dashboard: {{dashboardLink}}
